rows.name: Data and integrity profile
rows.product_question: Is the data underneath every other number complete enough to build on?

rows.name: Universe and survivorship statistics
rows.product_question: How much does the research universe turn over, and what does that mean for a result read as applying to a stable index?

rows.name: Descriptive and distributional statistics
rows.product_question: Which features actually vary, and which are so degenerate that any importance attributed to them should be discounted?

rows.name: Market and microstructure-proxy statistics
rows.product_question: How much microstructure information do daily proxies retain, and what is provably absent?

rows.name: Regime statistics
rows.product_question: Are the detected regimes stable and well-populated enough for a regime-conditioned result to be interpretable?

rows.name: Dependence and propagation statistics
rows.product_question: Do cross-instrument co-movement features carry information beyond the instrument's own series?

rows.name: Tail and extreme-risk statistics
rows.product_question: What does the tail of the realised return distribution look like over the rows this system scores?

rows.name: Episode and event statistics
rows.product_question: How many integrity episodes exist, how intense are they, and how are they distributed across instruments?

rows.name: Leakage and split verification
rows.product_question: Does any feature, split or threshold use information that was not available at the time of the decision?

rows.name: Validation and verification metrics
rows.product_question: How often is the model right, how often is it wrong, and in which direction?

rows.name: Calibration and uncertainty
rows.product_question: When the model reports a high score, is it right that often?

rows.name: Error analysis
rows.product_name: Where the signal gets it wrong
rows.product_question: What kind of rows does the model get wrong, and is the error concentrated anywhere?

rows.name: Baseline comparison
rows.product_question: Does the evidence stack outperform a simple statistical detector on the same rows and the same metric?

rows.name: Ablation study
rows.product_question: Which components carry the result, and which could be removed without changing it?

rows.name: Robustness and generalization
rows.product_question: How much does performance fall when features are noisy, stale, missing, or when there is less training data?

rows.name: Multi-seed and statistical significance
rows.product_name: What counts as a real difference
rows.product_question: Is an observed difference between two arms bigger than what re-seeding alone produces?
